wikipedia#7.title: 1950: Korean War: The Chinese People's Volunteer Army launched multiple attacks against United Nations forces, beginning the Battle of Chosin Reservoir.

wikipedia#8.title: 1945: A consortium of twenty-two U.S. charities founded CARE with the mission of delivering food aid to Europe in the aftermath of World War II.

wikipedia#9.title: 1944: Between 3,500 and 4,000 tonnes of ordnance exploded at the RAF Fauld underground munitions storage depot in the largest non-nuclear explosion in the United Kingdom.

wikipedia#10.title: 1943: World War II: Australian forces began the Battle of Wareo by conducting clearing operations between Bonga and North Hill.

wikipedia#11.title: 1895: Swedish chemist and industrialist Alfred Nobel (pictured) signed his last will and testament, setting aside the bulk of his estate to establish the Nobel Prize after his death.

wikipedia#12.title: 1868: American Indian Wars: George Armstrong Custer's 7th Cavalry Regiment attacked the encampment of Chief Black Kettle and the Cheyenne on the Washita River near present-day Cheyenne, Oklahoma.

wikipedia#13.title: 1856: William III (pictured) unilaterally revised the constitution of Luxembourg, greatly expanding his powers as grand duke.

wikipedia#14.title: 1835: James Pratt and John Smith became the last people to be executed in England for sodomy.

wikipedia#15.title: 1703: The great storm of 1703, one of the most severe storms to strike southern Great Britain, destroyed the first Eddystone Lighthouse off Plymouth.

wikipedia#16.title: 1161: Jin–Song wars: A Song fleet, equiped with trebuchets that launched incendiary bombs, defeated Jin ships in a naval engagement on the Yangtze River.
